appearance.themeDescription: Choose how Skyclause looks on this account.
appearance.duskNote: Navy ground, pink ink. The default.
appearance.systemNote: Dusk or Day, whichever your device is set to.
appearance.contrastDescription: More contrast draws every control and mark with a stronger edge.
appearance.contrastMoreNote: Stronger edges on every control and mark.
appearance.motionDescription: Animation and transitions move only a short way, and never carry meaning on their own.
appearance.motionSystemNote: Moves unless your device asks for less.
appearance.densityDescription: Compact uses 13px text and 40px rows. Comfortable uses 14px text and 44px rows.
appearance.languageDescription: Your language choice also sets the document locale.
appearance.languageHelp: The app’s pages show in this language, on every device you sign in on.
appearance.keyboardShortcutsDescription: Allow single-key actions where the focused screen supports them.
appearance.saveFailed: Your preference was not saved. Try again.

security.loadFailed: Your session has expired. Sign in again to manage account security.
security.genericFailure: The account security change could not be completed. Try again.
security.lastSignInMethod: This is your only way to sign in. Add a passkey or link Google first.
security.methodsDescription: Keep at least one way to sign in to your account.
security.magicLinkDescription: Allow sign-in by a one-time email link.
security.magicLinkOn: Magic link sign-in is on. A one-time email link signs you in.
security.magicLinkOff: Magic link sign-in is off. A one-time email link no longer signs you in.
security.newPasskeyHint: Name it after the device that holds it, such as Work laptop.
security.passkeyRemoved: Removed the passkey {name}. It can no longer sign in.
security.removePasskeyConsequence: The passkey stops working at once. Other ways to sign in are not changed.
security.googleNotLinked: Link a Google account for another sign-in method.
security.unlinkGoogleConsequence: Signing in with Google stops working at once. Other ways to sign in are not changed.
security.googleUnlinked: Unlinked Google. It can no longer sign in.
security.sessionsDescription: Review signed-in devices and revoke sessions you do not recognise.
security.revokeSessionConsequence: That device is signed out at once and its next request is refused.
security.sessionRevoked: Revoked the session on {name}. It is signed out.
security.signOutOthersDescription: All other sessions will be signed out. This device will stay signed in.
security.othersSignedOut: Signed out every other session. This device stays signed in.
security.passkeyNameRequired: Enter a name for the passkey.
